why: renderGroupedTable() always renders clones of the source rows, so a stamp on the live rows alone vanishes on the next filter pass. Must fail on 'the stamp survives a filter re-render'.

name: the family-painted guard is dropped
why: KNOWN GAP, recorded rather than hidden. The guard matters only on a cell carrying BOTH a family flag (length, video, no-work, live title) and a generic finding (ALL UPPERCASE, pending edits, …), where the generic ::after would out-rank the family's glyph. No fixture has such a cell: the live-title fixture's error titles are none of them ALL UPPERCASE or pending, so the family test passes without the guard (its findings' tint() is false on its own).
